Learn why InterMUN exists and how it supports Model United Nations conferences.
Built for the whole conference team.
Delegates can research, draft, collaborate, and follow committee activity.
Chairs can run roll call, speakers lists, motions, timers, and votes.
Advisors can support their delegations with appropriate visibility.
Secretariat teams can coordinate committees and understand conference-wide progress.
How InterMUN collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information.
Depending on how you use the service, we may collect:
Account details such as your name, email address, profile, and role.
Conference information, committee assignments, and participation records.
Content you create, including documents, notes, messages, votes, and submissions.
Files you upload and communications you send to conference teams or to us.
Technical and usage data needed to operate, secure, and improve the service.
Provide accounts, conference workspaces, and role-based features.
Deliver content to the participants and staff authorised to access it.
Maintain security, prevent abuse, troubleshoot problems, and improve reliability.
Respond to support, partnership, and conference enquiries.
Comply with applicable law and enforce our Terms of Service.
The terms governing access to and use of InterMUN.
Keep your credentials and conference access codes confidential.
Do not impersonate another person or misrepresent your role.
Do not access data, committees, or administrative tools you are not authorised to use.
Tell us or your organiser promptly if you suspect unauthorised account use.
